rec.name: Collection Product Card Image Slider (CRO | CP | Product Slider)
rec.status: Built — implemented on client theme (initially in live theme by mistake; should be hidden/tested in a duplicate theme)

what.text: An image slider inside each product card on the collection page grid. Shoppers can browse a product's gallery images directly in the grid using left/right arrows (and dot pagination below the image) without opening the PDP. The card still shows badge (e.g. BESTSELLER / SOLD OUT), title, colour name, product type, star rating, price and colour swatches (with '+N' overflow).

why.text: Lets shoppers see more of the product (angles, on-model, detail shots) at the moment of browsing, which reduces uncertainty and the need to click through to the PDP. This raises engagement and product-card-to-PDP quality, and keeps users exploring. Visual product exploration at the listing level also supports faster decisions on fashion/accessory items. The dots show how many images exist, creating a clear affordance.

how.text: Implemented as the reusable 'CRO | CP | Product Slider' block/section from the Sectionfy library, installed via the attached installation instructions (not visible in ticket). Replace the static card image with a slider containing the product's media, with prev/next arrow buttons and dot indicators. Build and QA in a duplicate/unpublished theme (or hidden by default), not in the live theme. The design reference (livefastdieyoung.com) turned out to use a second-image-on-hover rather than a slider, so the visual style was to be matched loosely; the ZOE LU screenshot shows the slider variant.

items: Arrows on/off (chevrons at left/right of image, left arrow greyed at first slide)
Number of images shown per product (inferred)
Visibility toggle to keep hidden initially for testing

dependencies.text: Shopify collection template with product cards; products need multiple media images. Installation instructions are attached to the original ordering ticket (not available here). Uses existing theme elements for badges, ratings (review app, stars visible) and colour swatches. Should be developed in a duplicated theme.

items: Conversion rate and revenue per session on collection pages
